jobs.title: DevOps inženjer
jobs.summary: DevOps inženjer će automatizovati i unapređivati procese deploymenta kako bi ubrzao isporuku i povećao stabilnost aplikacija. Kandidat će prikupljati i automatizovati konfiguracije te planirati i verifikovati deploymente na testnim i produkcionim okruženjima.
jobs.details: O poslodavcu Postani deo ekipe Banca Intesa DevOps inženjer Ko smo mi? Mi smo tim od gotovo 3000 koleginica i kolega širom Srbije. Slavimo jedinstvenost i negujemo kulturu otvorenog feedback-a, jer samo tako možemo rasti i razvijati se zajedno. Deo smo Intesa Sanpaolo, jedne od vodećih bankarskih grupa u Evropi, na tržištu Srbije smo 20 godina i poslujemo u više od 90 gradova naše zemlje. Verujemo da bez snažnih pojedinaca nema ni snažnih timova, ali i da samo jaki timovi mogu biti pravi oslonac i temelj za svaki individualni uspeh. Zajedno, svakodnevno brinemo o potrebama više od 1,3 miliona klijenata, gradeći čvrste odnose poverenja zasnovanih na ekspertizi i znanju. Naše vrednosti Verujemo u integritet i održivost našeg delovanja i poslovanja. Brinemo o klijentima kroz izvrsnost naših usluga i proizvoda negujući dugoročne odnose. Stvaramo inovacije i dodatnu vrednost za pojedince, kompanije i zajednice u kojima poslujemo. Gradimo održivu budućnost posvećenu očuvanju životne sredine, mladim generacijama i izgradnji istinski inkluzivnog društva. Zašto baš Banca Intesa? Svojim kolegama smo omogućili fleksibilno radno vreme i rad od kuće, kao i odlične prilike za razvoj kroz eksterne obuke, interne radionice i talent programe. Talentovanim kolegama pružamo priliku za internacionalnu karijeru. Brinemo o balansu, podstičemo zdrave životne navike i gradimo atmosferu dobre timske saradnje i podrške. Učestvujemo na brojnim sportskim aktivnostima i takmičenjima, kao i volonterskim aktivnostima u okviru programa „Intesa od srca“. Deci naših zaposlenih pružamo priliku da steknu dragocena međunarodna iskustva i razviju svoje veštine i talente, kroz učešće u sportskim takmičenjima i letnjim kampovima za decu. jobs.summary: Senior Android developer responsible for building and enhancing Android TV and set-top applications to deliver competitive OTT and hybrid viewing experiences. The role emphasizes producing high quality Java and Kotlin code, participating in design and code reviews, and working within agile teams to improve product quality and competitiveness.
jobs.details: O poslodavcu Machine Learning Engineer Novi Sad Your future field of work We are launching a set of new AI projects designed to deliver immediate, tangible value to our users. Just as importantly, we are building internal AI tooling to improve our software development processes and help our engineers build more effectively. This initiative involves projects spanning local LLMs, RAG systems, multi-agent workflows, and the semantic analysis of our engineering data. What we don't have yet is a team that properly owns this. That's the job. You will be the senior engineer in the room from day one: setting the technical direction, deciding what we build versus what we buy, and helping us hire the people who come next. Your role would include: Designing, building, and shipping machine learning solutions that run in embedded and real-time environments Taking models the whole way: data, training, optimization, integration, deployment, and the unglamorous monitoring afterwards. Establishing the foundational MLOps infrastructure Tailoring models for constrained targets (quantization, pruning) and making honest trade-offs between accuracy, memory, and latency Working across diverse domains and business units (embedded, DTV, Android, IoT, automotive, CI/CD). Their constraints are your constraints, and most of your design decisions will be made in conversation with them. Turning advanced AI concepts into practical tools. You will build RAG systems and multi-agent workflows to solve real bottlenecks in daily engineering work. Defining what we need, interviewing candidates, and establishing the engineering standards, tooling, and review practices the team will work by Providing structured engineering mentorship and helping us turn interns into colleagues Communication with stakeholders across the company. Part of the job is explaining what AI can realistically do for a given product and being equally clear about what it can't. You should be able to talk through something you built that real users depended on Hands-on experience with embedded and/or real-time systems: memory and CPU budgets, debugging on target hardware Advanced proficiency in Python Practical experience with machine/deep learning frameworks, as well as the MLOps tooling required to support them The ability to work without a fully defined roadmap. Early on, part of your job is deciding what the job is. jobs.title: Online Data Analyst - Serbian (RS)
jobs.summary: This role exists to verify and validate spatial and business data to ensure mapping accuracy and user-safe navigation. The contributor performs structured audits and root cause analyses and provides feedback that improves geographic intelligence and reduces real-world navigation errors.
jobs.details: TELUS Digital AI Community Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of more than one million contributors from diverse backgrounds who help customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and contribute to the development of innovative AI technologies used by some of the world's largest brands. Millions of people rely on digital maps every day to navigate, discover, and find their way. But maps are only as accurate as the data behind them, and data is only as trustworthy as the people who verify it. Your knowledge of Serbia's geography, local landmarks, and how people actually navigate your region is something no algorithm can fully replicate. That local intelligence is what makes maps genuinely useful. A Day in the Life of an Online Data Analyst In this role, you will conduct structured quality audits on spatial and mapping datasets. Your role is to verify, evaluate, and validate complex geographic and business information using advanced mapping tools and detailed reference materials. Conduct structured quality audits on spatial datasets using mapping platforms, search directories, and GIS-standard evaluation tools Evaluate and cross-reference complex business, geographic, and cultural data entries against multiple authoritative sources Perform root-cause analysis when spatial data points conflict across sources, documenting the discrepancy with precise reasoning Apply detailed evaluation frameworks with consistency and rigor across dozens of geographic, business, and cultural data variations Be open to working across a diverse set of task types, e.g. Maps, News, Audio tasks, Relevance Provide structured feedback that helps refine mapping algorithms and improve geographic intelligence Reference: idaPbsFmDQXiPphwqsBBf_H6hjKkem8aiq6MEIUsHm_B70d5FZzElzoOzbGTRN5r Why this matters: accurately verified mapping data prevents real-world navigation errors. Your verification work ensures people can reliably find critical services, reach trusted businesses, and navigate with confidence. At scale, this is infrastructure work that is foundational to how billions of people interact with geographic information. Why join the project: Fully remote flexibility: complete work from anywhere with stable internet, structuring your schedule around academic research, consulting, or other professional commitments Structured onboarding: access comprehensive evaluation guidelines, detailed reference materials, and practical examples before your first live assessment Direct feedback and growth: receive performance assessments tied to quality metrics so you can refine your evaluation precision Intellectually rigorous work: each evaluation requires methodical reasoning, framework interpretation, and structured discrepancy analysis Responsive support team: contact dedicated contributor operations staff for clarification on guidelines, technical issues, or administrative questions Requirements: Professional fluency in English and Serbian, Latin and Cyrillic script, native or near-native proficiency required Access to both Cyrillic and Latin keyboards is required Being open to working across a diverse set of task types, e.g. Maps, News, Audio tasks, Relevance Advanced analytical thinking and methodical problem-solving ability Deep regional, cultural, and geographic knowledge of Serbia Comfort with rigorous guideline interpretation and consistent framework application Bachelor's degr
